outcome: A credible, researched, financially sound, executable plan that satisfies the owner's original objective inside every stated limit, graded USABLE by an independent grader.

dimensions.R: Does the result reach every component that needs it?
dimensions.I: Does the result change later decisions correctly?
dimensions.F: Does Brain recognise and recover when it fails?
dimensions.X: Does it still work combined with the other capabilities?
dimensions.M: Is a failure the model's own, or Brain's instructions/software? (model isolated on the identical input)

RC1.name: Model turn is not checked before it counts
RC1.wrong: An empty reply (content "" with no error) or a 524 timeout from the primary model (gpt-oss-120b) is not treated as a failed turn to be retried on the same capable model; the turn falls to a weaker fallback. Reasoning models spend the max-token budget on hidden reasoning and return nothing.
RC1.proof: Replay: on the same prompts, empty replies retried with a larger budget answer; production route asks record zero empty-reply fall-throughs.
RC1.evidence: 30Q test: gpt-oss empty on 6/12 route asks; 524 at ~125 s on 2/3 question asks; integration diagnosis: 4/8 primary failures.

RC2.name: Critic veto is unchecked
RC2.wrong: The critic may drop any route on an assertion nothing verifies (date arithmetic, payment windows, fees the route never uses). Its word is final; when it drops all routes the owner gets no plan, even though the code can check most of what it asserts.
RC2.proof: Re-run the logged critiques: a drop resting on a false window/fee/capital claim is overruled by the deterministic check; outputs with zero surviving routes fall from 9/12.
RC2.evidence: 30Q: critic dropped 14 of 18 parsed routes; >=4 on misreadings (net-30 outside 60 days; Dec 3-7 after a Feb window; a $5 fee not used; service agreement as payment risk). Integration diagnosis: 6/8 asks ended empty, p10 false WINDOW x3.

RC3.name: A standing operating rule is presented as the owner's own constraint
RC3.wrong: Brain's operating-model sentence and REMOTE_AI_FOCUS are injected into goal prompts beside the owner's limits; models copy them into the owner's refusals and discovery searches online-only work for owners who offered labour or own equipment. The goal-specific lift exists only in the route prompt and only when a regex matches.
RC3.proof: Owner profiles in replies carry no refusal the owner did not state; discovery questions for an owner with stated labour/equipment are not online-only.
RC3.evidence: Integration diagnosis: 4/4 fallback replies invented refusals; 30Q p02 run 1 owner profile "no physical work" for a drone pilot. Partly repaired d5beaf6 (route prompt); discovery unchanged (code).

RC4.name: Verified findings are lost on the way to the planner
RC4.wrong: The proposer is shown at most 40 findings, newest first, with near-duplicates judged on the first 160 characters; refuted claims are not filtered; nothing selects findings by the decision they bear on.
RC4.proof: With all verified findings available, the planner's input holds every distinct verified finding (or a relevance-chosen set that covers every ground field), and a refuted claim is never shown.
RC4.evidence: 30Q: 40 of 111/111/135 delivered under the cap; uncapped near-dup filter dropped 6 and 9; graders attribute 3/12 failures to C. Code: refuted not filtered.

RC5.name: Inquiry and direction-finding anchor on one menu
RC5.wrong: Question generation and scouting fix on a business shape before research (brokered digital tasks, dropshipping) and never ask whether the owner can be paid directly for what they can do now; follow-ups narrow onto the same shape.
RC5.owner: routeProposal.ts directionPrompt (and the questions framing that reuses it); discovery lenses
RC5.proof: Fresh goals: the question set and directions include the owner's direct means and at least three structurally different mechanisms; p06-type goals surface direct paid work.
RC5.evidence: 30Q: p06 60 questions all brokerage/digital; p10 60 questions dropshipping/ad-services; graders: strongest p06 path (owner as Tasker) found by no output.

RC6.name: Research supply is starved
RC6.wrong: Fragments are not executed, 69% of searches are refused, no keyed search provider is configured, Firecrawl is held to 15 credits/day, and the read-capable routine workers are not members of evaluation projects.
RC6.owner: research coordinator/queue; server/services/sources/*; owner items (keyed search key)
RC6.proof: A fresh goal's research completes its planned fragments and its plan reads >=20 relevant verified facts within the goal window.
RC6.evidence: RESEARCH-STARVATION-DIAGNOSIS: 1/16 fragments completed; 30Q traces: 0/1/0 completions after ~6 h; searches 785/1142 refused.

RC7.name: No shared per-goal working state
RC7.wrong: Each faculty writes its conclusions to its own store; the next faculty re-derives or never reads them (rethink and calibration lessons, owner profile, committee questions, plan verdict and binding factor are not inputs to the route ask).
RC7.proof: A route ask's context shows the previous ask's rethink, the plan verdict and binding factor, and open committee questions; a lesson recorded once changes the next ask.
RC7.evidence: Integration diagnosis §2 "present but unused" (code and production).

RC8.name: Route economics are left to the model
RC8.wrong: Nothing computes, before a route counts, whether its price x realistic volume reaches the target, whether paid acquisition at the cited cost per sale fits the capital, or whether the buyer count supports the sales needed; models get the arithmetic wrong in both directions (proposer optimistic, critic pessimistic).
RC8.proof: Logged routes: the 445-sales-from-$3k beanie route is flagged by code; a sound route is not. The critic sees the computed figures.
RC8.evidence: 30Q graders: p10 beanie routes (445 sales from $3,000 at $39 CPA), p02 critic multiplying CPL by an inflated buyer count, p06 invented $10/h subcontractor.

RC9.name: Mechanical rules drop instead of repairing
RC9.wrong: A route missing a descriptive field (ownerFit) is rejected outright, and the whole output can be lost; no repair is asked.
RC9.proof: A route missing only ownerFit is kept with the owner fit derived or asked once; no output is lost to it.
RC9.evidence: 30Q p10 round-1 uncapped: both routes rejected OWNER_FIT, owner handed nothing (category E).

RC10.name: Knowledge links name no real segment
RC10.wrong: Sentence-fragment buyers are linked to Census/NAICS counts and the buyer question is closed as established.
RC10.proof: A fragment-shaped buyer gets an ESTIMATE that does not close the buyer question.

RC11.name: No single selector
RC11.wrong: Six generators and four selectors produce competing "best" answers in one reading; nothing arbitrates.
RC11.proof: One reading names one chosen strategy that acceptance, committee, report and operator all read.
RC11.evidence: Integration diagnosis §3 q6: four best answers, three binding diagnoses on wst_db2e.

RC12.name: Readiness cannot be reached by research
RC12.wrong: Plan acceptance needs every input evidenced at sample>=20 and p5 reach>=90%; research alone cannot move it, so "ready" is never signalled by a research-backed plan.
RC12.proof: A plan whose legs are each grounded by verified findings reaches an owner-usable readiness state distinct from the money-commitment gate.

repairs.what: askModel: an empty reply with no error is retried once with twice the token budget, then is an error; route asks, critiques and the eval probe use it.

Critic is shown exact computed economics and dates; told to REPAIR a disputed figure (re-checked by code) and DROP only for what no figure can fix; a drop resting only on WINDOW/CAPITAL is kept (ranked last) or re-checked as a repair.

routeEconomics/economicsLine: margin after direct and buyer cost, sales needed, acquisition spend, owner hours, first-cash date; a route whose buyers cost at least what a sale earns is refused (ACQUISITION); proposer asked for acquisitionCostPerSale and selling time in owner hours.
A route missing ownerFit is kept with the gap stated for the critic.
Findings: 120 shown (was 40); near-duplicates judged on the whole statement; past the budget, lanes taken in turn; refuted claims filtered where read (projectEvidenceClaims) and where shown.
Scouting and route asks: when the owner offers their own work, consider being paid directly first; named directions/routes must differ in who pays, for what, through which channel.
Discovery questions carry the online-only focus only when the goal offers no owner work; with an offer, the owner's direct paid work is searched first.
Each route ask reads the rethinks of earlier asks for the goal (lessons) instead of only recording them.
Research execution: fragments for goal research complete; search refusals; keyed search (owner key).
Knowledge links require a real segment; a fragment buyer gets an ESTIMATE that does not close the question.
One selector: the plan reading's chosen strategy is the single answer read by acceptance, committee, report and operator.
An owner-usable readiness state for a research-grounded plan, separate from the money-commitment gate.
Convert the chosen route into an executable step plan (who, when, cost, first action, acceptance) on the owner surface (C36).
